summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Orla Mining Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting that it has reached an agreement with employees and their union regarding the 2025 productivity bonus at its Camino Rojo mine. The agreement was approved by a majority of employees and signed before the Mexican Labour Authority. There are no financial terms, special-situation mechanics, or board recommendations disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update concerning labor relations, not a special situation event.
